channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ryan Dunn | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ryan Dunn from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Oso Ighodaro on Ryan Dunn
item.description:
Oso Ighodaro said Suns' identity shift starts now:

“Me and Ryan [Dunn] get to take a little bit more of a leadership role, being loud, vocal and really trying to build this new culture. I think that starts here. Start the groundwork in Summer League and then try to carry it over”

Oso Ighodaro on Ryan Dunn, Jul 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Cody Martin, Oso Ighodaro, Ryan Dunn
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Kevin Durant on the Suns switching more with Ryan Dunn, Oso Ighodaro and Cody Martin:

“I feel like that's the most effective way for us to guard is to be able to switch and guard 1-on-1....You've seen something that we maybe can add going forward with those 3”

Kevin Durant on Cody Martin, Oso Ighodaro, Ryan Dunn, Mar 19, 2025. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Ryan Dunn
item.description:
Bradley Beal on Ryan Dunn:

“Everybody had an opinion on him coming into the draft, and it's just so cool to be able to see kids and guys shut up that noise.... He's a very, very key piece to our team, for sure.”

Bradley Beal on Ryan Dunn, Nov 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: David Roddy on Ryan Dunn
item.description:
David Roddy on the importance of Ryan Dunn continuing to let it fly from 3:

“It’s almost weird sometimes, especially in Bud’s system, that he wants all of us to shoot and promotes it, actually. So just having that confidence and, again, just trusting the work.”

David Roddy on Ryan Dunn, Jul 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: James Jones on Ryan Dunn
item.description:
James Jones on Ryan Dunn's shot and what he showed in his Suns draft workout:

“He knew that was a narrative that was surrounding him, but he shot the ball exceptionally well, shot it with confidence, and what we realized was there's still a lot of work, a lot of room for growth”

James Jones on Ryan Dunn, Jul 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.
